items.quote: Adesh was professional, patient and knowledgeable in the topic. With a simple friendly conversation he was able to explain everything and make a cabinet that fit my needs perfectly. Top notch quality cabinets for all needs. Highly recommended.

We had a custom 20ft long entertainment center built for the great room in our home and we are very pleased with the end result. The professional craftsmanship that went into designing and building this beautiful entertainment center was impressive.
Roland's custom cabinets have crafted two separate kitchens for me within the last 10 years and their quality and services continue to improve with time. Their wood is beautifully finished.
